title: La Danta and El Tigre, oldest Maya pyramids

tellings.quote: That is the first known pyramid in it's called Ladanta. Ladanta and Ligra.

plain: La Danta and El Tigre, two huge pyramids at El Mirador, an ancient Maya city in the jungle of Guatemala, are among the very oldest pyramids the Maya built, according to Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient sites who says he has been there. He calls La Danta "the first known pyramid." He brings it up as part of his case that the pyramids are older and stranger than people usually think.
